{
  "name": "last-push",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "When this project was last committed and pushed, in one line under the Claude Code prompt: unpushed commits, uncommitted files, staleness colour and a reminder",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Display",
      "description": "full: the whole line · compact: symbols only · off: hidden",
      "default": "full"
    },
    "reminders": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Reminders",
      "description": "A toast when commits sit unpushed, or files uncommitted, longer than the stale time — once per state",
      "default": true
    },
    "remindAfter": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Stale after (hours)",
      "description": "Hours until waiting work turns red and the reminder fires; 0 turns both off",
      "default": 4,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 720
    }
  },
  "author": {
    "name": "Martin Pfeffer",
    "email": "martin.pfeffer@celox.io",
    "url": "https://celox.io"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/pepperonas/last-push",
  "repository": "https://github.com/pepperonas/last-push",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "function-hooks",
    "ui",
    "git",
    "push",
    "commit",
    "status"
  ]
}
